data.body: [P1] These commands also run when `BUILT_THIS_RUN` is false, recreating an already-published `v$VERSION` from mutable architecture tags. A concurrent retry can update those tags with different image digests and fail; the next recovery then silently rewrites the existing release manifest and verification passes against the rewritten digest. Only create `v$VERSION` after a fresh build. For recovery and `latest`, copy the exact existing top-level manifest instead, and test that this path never pushes `v$VERSION`.
